hints.title: Sorting for Pairwise Bound Invariance
hints.text: Sorting the array enables determining the count of valid triplets without checking each third element individually.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Range Sum Addition
hints.text: For a fixed first element nums[i], if nums[i] plus nums[left] plus nums[right] is strictly less than target, all pairs between left and right are also valid.

hints.title: Right-Left Distance Cumulative Count
hints.text: Iterate index i from 0 to n minus 3. Maintain left at i plus 1 and right at n minus 1. If sum is less than target, add right minus left to total and advance left; otherwise decrement right.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N^2) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all triplets through three nested loops takes cubic O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting the array in O(N log N) allows each inner scan to evaluate O(N) pairs simultaneously via index difference.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize the right minus left counting trick when the sum satisfies the inequality.
